prompt: Origin: drawn for this project as an HTML/CSS spec sheet using the site's own fonts (Big Shoulders, Big Shoulders Stencil, Barlow) on a plain board in the same colour as the P-01 cover: one slot with its plate lifted (P-02, heavy outline for Active), the plate showing the real Bookkeeping home screen (docs/assets/screenshots/home.light.webp from the bookkeeping repo at 9593c6c, a fictional demo account) beside a sentence-case Barlow heading and a short line about the app, callouts for each part, and the outline key for the four project statuses. Slot outline, leader lines, dots and key boxes are drawn in rim grey; line type carries the status. Rendered with headless Chromium (Playwright) at 2880x1620, downscaled to 1440x810 and encoded to WebP at quality 85 with sharp. Not generated by an image model.
